top_issues: In the primary balance header, 'At risk $300.91 · you owe $100.00' mixes liability and credit counterparty risk in the same visual weight as net balance, confusing net worth with gross exposure.
The absolute scale ruler label '1 px = $1 · auto · 1 empty hidden' is quiet and easy to miss, meaning users don't immediately realize the horizontal violet bar represents true linear proportionality.
Under ACCOUNTS (H1 hub), the dual mini-bar has an unbalanced right label 'receive up to 215.50' vs 'send up to 0.00', lacking an explicit visual zero anchor.
fixes: Separate 'Net Equity ($200.91)' from 'Active Counterparty Exposure / Debt' using a distinct badge or sub-row.
Add a subtle ticks/ruler legend directly underneath the asset bar cards so the 1 px = $1 metaphor is self-explanatory.
Label the bilateral credit line bar with clear explicit markers: [You Owe | Zero | They Owe].

top_issues: The oversized QR code sits on an inverted harsh white rounded square in the center of an otherwise dark UI, pulling 90% of visual weight away from the input fields.
The capacity constraint indicator '215.50 capacity via H1' sits above the amount field with zero explanation of what happens if someone pays 250 USDC.
The entity ID '0xd791...dc91' is truncated without a direct 1-click verify checksum or human-readable alias.
fixes: Tame the QR card container with a subtle quiet border or dark-mode compliant QR styling with high-contrast quiet zone.
Add an inline alert when entered amount exceeds inbound capacity with an immediate 'Request Hub Inbound Credit' action.
Display Entity ID with split checksum blocks and an instant 'Copy ID' button beside 'Copy invoice'.

top_issues: Error message 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' is rendered in red below the inputs, but provides no one-click action to resolve or reserve the incoming route.
Order book right column shows depth bars, but doesn't show cumulative sum or your own placed order marker directly in the ladder.
The toggle between 'Same network' and 'Across networks' in top right is decoupled from the swap input card.
fixes: Turn 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' into an interactive actionable link button that prompts the needed credit line change.
Add a cumulative depth visual curve and explicit price tick highlight on the book when tapping a price row.
Embed the route type ('Same network / Across networks') directly into the token selector or execution path box.

top_issues: In USDC lane, '-100.00 you owe them' with green bar under Collateral 100.00 creates cognitive conflict (green usually means positive balance, here it signifies posted collateral).
The distinction between 'Their credit line to you (0.00)' and 'Your credit line to them (115.50)' requires deep mental translation for non-Lightning users.
Action buttons 'Pay', 'Extend credit', 'Swap', 'Manage' at the top don't specify which currency lane they apply to when multiple lanes (USDC, WETH) exist.
fixes: Add visual legend directly above the lane cards tying green strictly to on-chain collateral and violet/amber to unsecured credit lines.
Rewrite lines to conversational terms: 'Max they can owe you' vs 'Max you can owe them'.
Group lane-specific actions into the lane cards themselves or provide a currency context selector.

top_issues: Massive dead void on the right and lower half of the screen; the activity feed occupies only a narrow band, wasting desktop canvas.
Detail panel for 'Swap filled' in the upper right is tiny, detached, and shows only Frame #63 and Time, missing executed rate, fill amounts, counterparty, and cryptographic proof hash.
No search, counterparty filter, or export CSV/proof bundle button visible on the main activity interface.
fixes: Expand the detail panel into a full-height right inspector showing complete state transition: before/after balance, signed frame hash, and audit proof.
Add an 'Export audit proof' and 'Download CSV' action bar next to the filter pills.
Populate the activity row with counterparty badge and asset icons for faster visual parsing.

top_issues: Identical to 07-activity; selecting a transaction does not change layout to a true deep dive or show cryptographic frame signatures.
Lack of transaction receipt sharing mechanism (no link to copy, no printable receipt for clients).
Shows 'From your runtime's committed frames' without a clickable raw JSON or Merkle verification link.
fixes: Include a 'Share Receipt' button that generates a verified payment slip link or signed receipt image.
Provide an expandable drawer for cryptographic verification: Frame root, Hub sig, Client sig, State delta.
Fill the vast empty canvas with a two-pane master-detail layout where selecting an item updates a detailed inspection sheet.

top_issues: The 'At this scale' preview card on the top right is purely illustrative and detached from actual active wallet balances.
Danger zone action 'Forget vault' is in red next to 'Lock', but lacks explicit warning about unbacked state channels or in-flight settlement risk.
Guided tour button is relegated to a small standard secondary button near the bottom instead of being accessible during onboarding.
fixes: Include a toggle in the scale card to 'Preview my balances at this scale' directly in the preview card.
Add a pre-check modal on 'Forget vault' stating active locked bilateral channel balances that would be forfeited.
Move onboarding and sandbox tour triggers into a dedicated top-level banner or help menu.

top_issues: Error message 'Amount exceeds what is available here' sits at the bottom left below the primary action button rather than inline next to the input.
The distinction between moving to 'Wallet', 'Reserve', and 'Account' is abstract; the small text 'Depository escrow' and 'Bilateral, instant' requires reading all cards to grasp the architecture.
The right-side 'WHAT HAPPENS' card explains 'Fund you through H1' but does not itemize on-chain gas costs vs instant zero-fee state changes.
fixes: Place available balance helper directly clickable (e.g. 'Max: 0.00') inside the amount input field, disabling submit before click.
Add an interactive architectural diagram icon linking Wallet (L1) -> Reserve (Escrow) -> Account (Hub Channel).
Itemize fees explicitly in 'WHAT HAPPENS': Gas estimate (L1 tx required) vs Protocol fee ($0.00).

top_issues: Sparse navigation hub with enormous unused negative space; 5 small cards occupy the top-left quadrant leaving 70% of the screen blank.
Navigation cards look like static status cards rather than clickable navigation routes.
Right sidebar shows H1 hub account with '3 lanes · 13 frames · open' but gives no quick actions or summary metrics directly.
fixes: Turn Manage into a rich executive dashboard showing overall system health, open disputes, proof status, and counterparty summaries.
Add explicit chevron icons and hover elevation states to Sovereignty, Move, Assets, Lending, Ownership tiles.
Show real-time counterparty risk and pending frame confirmations inside the Accounts card.

top_issues: The FAUCETS panel on the right takes up equal hierarchy with actual user assets, looking like a developer testnet console rather than a financial application.
The statement 'Depository may pull 0.00' is technical contract jargon that provides zero clarity to an end user.
Debts card at bottom is flat text; lacks visual representation of potential liquidation or margin call conditions.
fixes: Collapse testnet faucets into a dedicated 'Testnet Tools' modal or drawer, replacing that column with real deposit/withdraw on-chain flows.
Change 'Depository may pull' to 'Approved for reserve deposit: $0.00' with an 'Approve' action button.
Give Debts a dedicated state indicator showing 'Clean record (0 obligations)' with collateral threshold warnings.

top_issues: Interest rate input asks for 'basis points' (100) — while it converts to '= 1.00% per term', expecting users to input basis points creates unnecessary friction.
The toggle between 'Lend' and 'Borrow' is small, subdued, and placed awkwardly between token selection and amount input.
The right-side 'H1 POOL' stats show Available 0.00, Borrowed 0.00, Principal 0.00 without any utilization rate or pool health graphs.
fixes: Make APR/APY the primary input field with automatic basis-points translation underneath.
Place the Lend / Borrow segment switch at the very top of the form as the primary intention selector.
Add pool utilization visual progress bars and historical yield indicators in the H1 Pool panel.

top_issues: Massive empty screen real estate with only one card 'BOARD' and a tiny 'TAKE CONTROL' placeholder.
Terms like 'Lazy (hash of its board)' and 'EntityProvider' leak internal protocol abstractions with zero plain-English explanation.
No management actions available for adding signers, changing threshold, or initiating entity transfer.
fixes: Replace internal jargon ('Lazy entity') with clear multi-sig / governance governance labels (e.g., 'Off-chain Key Threshold: 1 of 1').
Add actionable controls: 'Add Co-Signer', 'Export Governance Spec', and 'Register On-Chain'.
Provide an activity log of board changes and signature threshold history.

top_issues: Text in the right card overlaps or compresses uncomfortably: 'they answer in... you owe 100.00' text collisions appear in the counterparty card.
The dispute trigger is absent: 'Can dispute without asking: 1 of 1' is shown, but there is no 'Initiate Dispute / Challenge Hub' action button.
'Save evidence bundle' downloads data, but doesn't show what the bundle contains (frame signatures, state tree hashes, channel nonces).
fixes: Fix the CSS text collision in the 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card by wrapping liability details into a structured two-column grid.
Add a visible, protected 'Initiate Challenge / Exit to L1' button with challenge timer preview.
Include an 'Inspect Bundle' modal to preview the cryptographic proof before saving.

top_issues: Dense table header columns ('LINES OUT · IN', 'SEND · RECEIVE') lack explicit hover tooltips explaining directional flow relative to client vs hub.
Order book and account table sit side-by-side but clicking an account lane does not automatically switch the book pair to that asset.
Top status strip shows 'NET $200.91', 'YOURS ON-CHAIN $0.00', 'AT RISK $300.91', but does not show aggregate liquidation distance or health factor.
fixes: Add explicit tooltips or column glossaries on table headers for institutional operator clarity.
Link account lane selection directly to the active order book pair (e.g. clicking WETH row loads WETH/USDC book).
Add an overall Account Health / Risk ratio gauge in the top summary band.

top_issues: Command palette modal is positioned slightly high, leaving keyboard shortcut hints ('⌘K') somewhat detached from the input bar.
No categorized section headers (e.g. 'Actions', 'Views', 'Settings') in the results list, making it a flat unorganized list.
Subtitles for actions are uneven ('batch, attention, doors' vs 'on-chain wallet, faucets, debts' vs 'send money').
fixes: Group command palette entries under clear group dividers: 'Navigation', 'Finances', 'System & Security'.
Standardize command descriptions with uniform imperative phrasing.
Add quick keyboard hotkey hints on individual item rows (e.g., 'P' for Pay, 'S' for Swap).

overall.verdict: The design establishes a masterclass in deterministic dark-mode financial density, replacing crypto hand-waving with honest, mathematically scaled representations of bilateral risk and on-chain collateral. However, it still suffers from technical jargon leakage, occasional layout emptiness on secondary screens, and missing end-to-end receipt and dispute execution controls.
priority_fixes: Add explicit, step-by-step dispute and on-chain challenge buttons to Sovereignty (15) and Account (06) rather than passive status indicators.
Replace developer-centric jargon ('Lazy entity', 'Depository pull', 'basis points', 'Lines out/in') with intuitive institutional financial terms across all views.
Implement a complete transaction receipt sharing and proof-verification sheet in Activity (07, 08).
Connect incoming capacity warnings directly to 1-click credit extension requests on Swap (05) and Receive (04).
Redistribute wide-screen layouts on Manage (11), Ownership (14), and Activity (07) to eliminate dead voids and display multi-pane inspectors.
